scope: fresh isolated Windows x64/CPython 3.13.14 CPU dependency installation and local integrated source tests; no deployment or paid provider calls

source.note: The integrated repository was being finalized during verification; coordinator confirmed intervening source changes were documentation/comments, with browser setup-helper tests added. This is clean-environment evidence, not certification of an immutable release commit.

installation.integrity: Every downloaded wheel matched SHA-256 from official PyPI metadata or the official PyTorch CPU wheel index before installation.
installation.method: pip install --no-index --find-links VERIFIED_WHEELHOUSE -r requirements.txt -c constraints-release.txt, followed by optional Playwright from the same verified wheelhouse
installation.index_observation: Initial child pip attempts received network socket permission errors. Root pip attempts enumerated no FastAPI distributions, including without constraints. Official JSON APIs exposed compatible published versions. The local verified-wheelhouse installation resolved and installed successfully; no missing-version inference is made.

hash_lock.canonicalisation: Published lock uses LF newlines; recorded installation input used CRLF. Requirements and per-wheel hashes are unchanged.
